04 / Keep it consistent

A few simple rules.

A little care makes a big difference. Give the logo room, use the right version and let the identity speak for itself.

01 / SPACE & SCALE

Room to breathe.

Leave clear space of at least half the height of the letter “o” around the wordmark. Keep its original proportions.

For small, square placements, use the N symbol instead of squeezing in the full wordmark.

Keep proportionsLeave clear space
02 / COLOUR & CONTRAST

The right background.

Use the charcoal-and-yellow wordmark on white or very light backgrounds. Choose white-and-yellow for dark charcoal.

Do not recolour, stretch or rotate the logo, or add outlines, shadows or effects to the supplied artwork.

Light on lightDark on dark
03 / NAME & ARTWORK

Write it NeroPay.

In headings and body copy, write NeroPay, with a capital N and P. The lowercase wordmark is artwork, not a font to recreate.

The supplied logos are raster assets. Use their original resolution; large-format print needs suitable vector artwork.
